versions.changelog:
Initial release of Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper.

- Provides structured workflows, checklists, and decision aids for SkillScan-style productivity and security tasks.
- Designed to address validated demand for bug fixing, setup hardening, and reliability improvement in agent-based environments.
- Focuses on practical, locally-executable solutions rather than cloud-dependent approaches.
- Includes clear validation steps and prompt tailoring for user-specific needs.

- Initial release of the Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper.
- Provides practical workflows and support for SkillScan-style productivity and security tasks, focusing on reliability, safety, and bug fixing.
- Designed for AI-agent users, skill authors, and teams seeking proven, reusable patterns and checklists.
- Favors local-hardware friendly solutions (scripts, templates, CPU-safe workflows) over cloud-only options.
- Includes clear validation steps to ensure outputs meet user requirements and are ready for direct use.
